# JJMasterData

> JJMasterData is a .NET library for generating CRUD interfaces and HTTP APIs from data dictionaries. Its ASP.NET Core UI combines metadata, field components, expressions, validation rules, actions and database persistence.

The current Web project targets .NET 10. Start with installation and the first dictionary, then use the relevant guide or recipe. Links are relative to this file so they work when the documentation is hosted under a subpath.

Dictionary metadata and business records use separate repositories. Saving metadata does not migrate the database. The host owns authentication and authorization. Direct repository writes and SQL actions bypass the normal form-event and audit workflow; standalone data panels do not attach form handlers automatically.

## Cookbook

- [Cookbook index](articles/cookbook/index.html): Scenario overview and recipe selection.
- [Customize a read procedure](articles/cookbook/read-procedure.html): Joined descriptions and calculated columns with filtering and pagination.
- [Customize a write procedure](articles/cookbook/write-procedure.html): Database validation, insert/update/delete contract and generated keys.
- [Persist multiple selections](articles/cookbook/multiple-selections.html): Translate a multiple-choice field into a relationship table.
- [Edit values in a grid](articles/cookbook/editable-grid.html): Built-in grid saves and application-owned batch editing.
- [Validate business operations](articles/cookbook/business-validation.html): Cross-field validation, imports and deletion checks.
- [Run a bulk action](articles/cookbook/bulk-action.html): Execute a database command for selected primary keys.
- [Create a task-specific form](articles/cookbook/task-form.html): Server-defined context and an explicit form-service save.
- [Save a header and its lines together](articles/cookbook/composed-document.html): MVC editor with validation, stable row keys and one transactional save.
- [Add application expression functions](articles/cookbook/custom-expression-functions.html): Reusable calculations and request-aware expression functions.

- [Show a status guide with HTML templates](articles/cookbook/html-templates.html): Complete HtmlTemplateAction with fictional SQL data, multiple result sets and a self-contained Liquid template.
